strata.name: Shallow
strata.line: Back in the shallow rock: coal, ice and iron.

strata.name: Mid
strata.line: The rock turns cold and blue. Uranium and gold lie this deep.

strata.name: Deep
strata.line: The light thins. The stone here is old and green-grey.

strata.name: Abyss
strata.line: Umber rock, and almost no light. Ore burns bright in the dark.

strata.name: Core
strata.line: The Core. Bedrock lies at 400 m.
